target: #STEEL_BLUE#围绕着你的奥术能量消退了。

source: #CRIMSON#%s has been yanked back to the tether!
Hits the target with your weapon doing %d%% damage. If the attack hits, the target is knocked back up to 4 grids.  The chance improves with your Physical Power.
target: 使用武器打击目标造成 %d%% 伤害，如果攻击命中则可击退目标至多 4 格。击退几率受物理强度加成。

source: Claws and teeth. Ice and death. Dragons are not all extinct it seems...
target: 尖牙利齿，冰冷致命。似乎龙族并没有完全灭绝……

deep_observation: 语义误译（组件 tome，公开源码 game/modules/tome/data/lore/misc.lua，固定 commit 624a67329fe2ad440c5b344785a9c73fcf22ae63，第 286-288 行 newLore{id=「ancient-elven-ruins-note-2」} 的 lore 字面量，blob 2bb59d0ae9270a2c3dffe7e264689a29a61a1fb6）：其一，原文 treated with the correct chemicals 意为「用正确的化学药剂处理」，译文作「就像是对待真正的实验品一样」，与原文无对应关系，且把防腐工序写成了比喻；其二，I demand a greater fate 的 fate 是「命运」，译作「机遇」改变了亡灵法师索求更高命运的语义；其三，My greatness cannot be allowed to fade 意为「我的伟大不容消逝/褪色」，译作「我的伟大不容亵渎」，fade 与「亵渎」不同义，也与上句「日子屈指可数、力量流逝」的衰亡主题脱节；另 the empty halls of my mausoleum 的 halls（陵墓厅堂）在「阴森森的坟墓」中丢失，且 empty 被替换为原文没有的「阴森森」。
source:
Death mocks my experiments. I can preserve the flesh of my servants, tightly wrapped and salted, treated with the correct chemicals. I can animate them, make them shuffle about the empty halls of my mausoleum. But they are but empty shells, devoid of any soul. Is this how my majesty is to end? I demand a greater fate...

My days are numbered. Each night that passes saps strength from me. I must find the way to preserve my soul within my flesh. My greatness cannot be allowed to fade.
surface_observation: treated with the correct chemicals（用合适的化学药剂处理）被误译为“就像是对待真正的实验品一样”；My greatness cannot be allowed to fade（我的伟大不能消逝）被误译为“我的伟大不容亵渎”。
target:
死亡嘲弄着我的实验。我可以保存侍从们的血肉，将他们用盐防腐后紧紧的包裹起来，就像是对待真正的实验品一样。我可以复活他们，使他们在我阴森森的坟墓里晃悠。但他们不过是没有任何灵魂的容器。这意味着我的霸业要结束了？我需要更好的机遇……

我的日子屈指可数。我的力量随着每个夜晚逐渐流逝。我必须找到将灵魂保存在肉体里的方法。我的伟大不容亵渎。

source: You have become wary of danger in your journeys. You have a %d%% chance of not triggering traps.
target: 你的行动变得更加谨慎，有 %d%% 几率不会触发陷阱。

source: A bolt of ice blasts onto @target@!
Just before your lips touch, you sense that something is very wrong.
target: 在你们俩嘴唇相碰之前，你注意到有什么不对劲……

source: The target has been directly exposed to arcane energies and has responded by reasserting it's connection to nature, restoring %0.1f Equilibrium per turn.
target: 目标被奥术力量伤害，重新联系自然，每回合回复 %0.1f 失衡值。

source: Learn an unarmed attack talent or enable 'Always show glove combat' to see combat stats.
target: 学习空手攻击技能，或者开启 '强制显示手套战斗数据' 选项来查看战斗数据。

source: They have access to #GOLD#special ghoul talents#WHITE# and a wide range of undead abilities:
target: 他们能使用 #GOLD#特殊的食尸鬼技能#WHITE# 和种类繁多的不死系能力：

source:
During your adventures you will encounter a variety of terrains you can pass on: grass, sand, water, lava, ...

Some of those terrains have innate penalties or tricks. You will have to learn them and how to deal with them.

You are about to enter a pond of water; you will not be able to breath inside. When you are in an area where you cannot breathe, an "Air" counter will appear on the left side of the screen. Do not let it reach zero or you will die.

Now go to the other side of the pond.
target:
在你的冒险旅途中，你将遇到各种可以通行的地形：草地、沙地、水域、熔岩……

其中一些地形带有天生的惩罚或机制。你必须了解它们并学会如何应对。

你即将进入一片水池；你在水中将无法呼吸。当你处于无法呼吸的区域时，屏幕左侧会出现一个“空气”计数器。切勿让它归零，否则你将会死亡。

现在前往水池的另一侧吧。

source: They're creatures of pure flame, and likely of extraplanar origin, but the ash of objects consumed by their fire has remarkable properties.
target: 它们是由纯粹的火焰组成的生物，似乎来自另一个世界。然而，由它们的火焰燃烧成的灰烬有着非凡的功效。

source:
You have discovered Zigur, the bastion of Nature fighting against all arcane magics.
Magic has caused so much pain and suffering on the world, it needs to stop.

All your new characters will now be able to betray arcane escort quests to send them to Zigur, granting new, different, rewards.
target:
你发现了伊格，一个对抗所有奥术力量的自然堡垒。
魔法给世界带来了如此多的痛苦与苦难，必须让它停止。

现在，你的所有新角色都可以背叛奥术护送任务，将护送对象送往伊格，从而获得新的、不同的奖励。

source: They possess the #GOLD#Luck of the Little Folk#WHITE# which allows them to increase their critical strike chance and saves for a few turns.
target: 他们天生掌握 #GOLD#小不点的幸运#WHITE# 技能，可以使他们在几个回合内提高暴击几率和豁免。

source: frozen and shattered into a million little shards
target: 被冰冻后碎裂为数百万冰晶

source:
Surround yourself with a shield that will absorb %d%% of any lightning/blight/darkness/mind attack, up to a maximum of %d damage per attack.
		Every time your shield absorbs damage, you convert some of the attack into energy, gaining one point of Psi, plus an additional point for every %0.1f points of damage absorbed, up to a maximum %0.1f points each turn.
		At talent level 3, when you de-activate the shield twice the absorbed damage (if any) in the last 3 turns is released as a full psionic shield (absorbing all damage).
		The maximum amount of damage your shield can absorb and the efficiency of the psi gain scale with your mindpower.
		You can only have two of these shields active at once.
target:
用护盾环绕自己，吸收 %d%% 闪电、枯萎、暗影、精神伤害，每次最多吸收 %d 伤害。
		每次你的护盾吸收伤害时，将部分攻击转化为能量，获得 1 点灵能值；每吸收 %0.1f 点伤害，还会额外获得 1 点灵能值，每回合最多获得 %0.1f 点灵能值。
		技能等级达到 3 时，关闭护盾会将此前 3 回合吸收的伤害（若有）的两倍转化为一个全效灵能护盾（吸收所有伤害）。
		护盾每次最多能吸收的伤害以及获得灵能值的效率随精神强度提高。
		你同时只能维持两个此类护盾。

deep_observation: 机制信息缺失与术语自相矛盾（组件 tome，公开源码 game/modules/tome/data/talents/techniques/munitions.lua，固定 commit 624a67329fe2ad440c5b344785a9c73fcf22ae63，blob 791b45b52e70b27f9d49e889aa2353ed06265e12，天赋 Alloyed Munitions 的 info 字面量第 441-445 行）：其一，第 443 行 which applies numbing poison as per Exotic Munitions 对同文件第 36 行 name = 「Exotic Munitions」 天赋的交叉引用在译文中被整条删除，玩家无法得知麻痹毒素的数值依 Exotic Munitions 结算；同句 an additional（额外）也丢失，译文「造成 %d%% 自然武器伤害」读作替换而非叠加。其二，第 444 行 maim the target 对应同文件第 263 行 target:setEffect(target.EFF_MAIM, 5, {src=self, power=t2.getPhysicalDamage(self,t2)/5, reduce=t2.getNumb(self,t2)}) 所施加的致残（MAIM）状态，译文仅写「使目标流血」，致残这一具名负面状态丢失，而流血与减伤本就是该状态的下属效果。其三，第 445 行 armor penetration 为「护甲穿透」，译文末句作「护甲和豁免削减受物理强度加成」，把穿透改写成削减；同一条目第 442 行的 physical and fire penetration 已译作「物理和火焰穿透」，前后对同一 penetration 用词不一致。
source:
You mix together your munitions, leading to powerful new effects:
Incendiary - Targets struck by the explosion have their armor and saves reduced by %d for 3 turns, and your physical and fire penetration is increased by %d%%.
Venomous - Shots deal an additional %d%% weapon damage as nature in a radius %d ball, which applies numbing poison as per Exotic Munitions. This cannot occur more than once per turn.
Piercing - Shots deal %0.2f physical damage and maim the target, bleeding them for a further %0.2f physical damage over 5 turns and reducing all damage dealt by %d%%.
The physical damage dealt, armor penetration and save reduction will increase with your Physical Power.
surface_observation: 剧毒弹部分漏译 additional（额外伤害）及 as per Exotic Munitions（毒素效果参照该技能），丢失伤害叠加和效果参照信息。
target:
混合你的弹药，造成更强力的效果：
燃烧弹- 受到爆炸袭击的目标护甲和豁免减少 %d 持续 3 回合，你的物理和火焰穿透增加 %d%%.
剧毒弹- 造成 %d%% 自然武器伤害，伤害半径 %d，并施加麻痹毒素效果。每回合最多生效一次。
穿甲弹- 造成 %0.2f 物理伤害并使目标流血，5 回合内造成 %0.2f 物理伤害并减少他们造成的伤害 %d%%.
物理伤害、护甲和豁免削减受物理强度加成。

source: A Human warrior, clad in shining plate armour. Power radiates from him.
target: 一位身披闪亮板甲的人类战士。力量从他身上散发出来。

source: Avoid fragments that contained the xorn's eyes. You've no idea how unpleasant it is being watched by your ingredients.
target: 不要带回包含着索尔石怪眼睛的碎片。你不知道被你的原材料盯着是多么难受的一件事。
被杀时重置冲锋冷却时间。

source: As you approach the tower you notice it is utterly destroyed, only the basement remaining.
target: 当你靠近高塔时，你发现它已被彻底摧毁，只剩下地下室还在。

source: This creatures psionic focus item is supercharged!
target: 这个生物的灵能聚焦物品被超载充能了！

source: A vial of thick maroon fluid.
How to make your foes feel the pain.
target: 让你的对手尝尝什么是真正的痛苦……

deep_observation: 增译与漏译（组件 tome，公开源码 game/modules/tome/data/talents/techniques/techniques.lua，固定 commit 624a67329fe2ad440c5b344785a9c73fcf22ae63，blob 40789aa7d887287699713cbb8048a59cc876526b，第 39 行 newTalentType{ type=「technique/field-control」, name=_t(「field control」,「talent type」), generic=true, description=_t「Control the battlefield using various techniques.」}）：原文只有「运用各种技巧控制战场」一层意思，译文「你时刻注意控制战场的状况，提升你的格斗效果」凭空增加了「时刻注意」和「提升你的格斗效果」两项原文没有的内容，后者更是对天赋类型效果的实质性断言（该系为通用控场系，description 不含任何格斗强化承诺，同文件第 40-41 行另有 combat techniques / combat veteran 系才是格斗向）；同时原文 using various techniques 这一「凭借多种技巧」的手段说明在译文中丢失。
source: Control the battlefield using various techniques.
surface_observation: 原文为运用各种技巧控制战场；译文遗漏各种技巧，并增添提升格斗效果的含义。
target: 你时刻注意控制战场的状况，提升你的格斗效果。

source: The target's reactions have quickened, giving +%d%% global speed.
target: 目标的反应速度变快了，全局速度提升 %d%%。

source: You fire multiple arrows at an area of %d radius, doing %d%% damage with each arrow.
target: 你向 %d 码半径区域内射出多支箭，每只箭造成 %d%% 伤害。

deep_observation: 限定语丢失导致机制说明绝对化（组件 tome，公开源码 game/modules/tome/class/interface/TooltipsData.lua，固定 commit 624a67329fe2ad440c5b344785a9c73fcf22ae63，blob 52052d43805d8849ed2d11a33c305d0e3602cfbb，第 184-187 行 TOOLTIP_PASSIVE 字面量）：第 186 行原文为 are usually not dispellable or removable，usually 是关键限定；译文「这些效果始终存在，不会被解除，也不会被移除」把「通常不会」改写成无例外的绝对断言，与紧接其后同句的 though other effects may counteract or negate them（译文「但是有些特殊效果可能会抵消或消除它们」）直接冲突，使同一条提示自相矛盾，并会让玩家误以为被动效果绝无被解除/移除的可能。
source:
#GOLD#Passive Talents#LAST#
When learned, passive talents permanently alter the user in some way.
The effects are always present and are usually not dispellable or removable, though other effects may counteract or negate them.
Specific information on each talent appears its tooltip.
surface_observation: 原文说通常无法驱散或移除，译文遗漏通常，将其表述为绝对不会被解除或移除。
target:
#GOLD#被动技能#LAST#
当你学会被动技能之后，它会以某种方式永久性的给玩家带来改变。
这些效果始终存在，不会被解除，也不会被移除，但是有些特殊效果可能会抵消或消除它们。
有关技能的详细信息，请参阅技能的提示框。

deep_observation: 用词错误与增译（组件 tome，公开源码 game/modules/tome/data/zones/ruins-kor-pul/npcs.lua，固定 commit 624a67329fe2ad440c5b344785a9c73fcf22ae63，blob 746a492be0b75daf1266ade41320258024ccf6d1，第 48 行 killer_message = _t「and left to rot」，同 NPC 定义见第 45-51 行）：其一，rot 指尸体「腐烂」，译文用「腐蚀」，后者指化学侵蚀，属词义错误；其二，原文只说被弃置任其腐烂，没有地点信息，译文增译「野外」，而该 NPC 属 ruins-kor-pul（科尔普废墟）地下城，与「野外」不符。该字段是拼接到死亡记录句尾的从句（同版本 game/modules/tome/class/GameState.lua 第 3529 行有平行用法 a.killer_message = _t「but nobody knew why they suddenly became evil」），译文以「并抛尸野外任其腐蚀」承接时，既引入了错误地点又用错了腐烂一词。
surface_observation: rot 指腐烂，译成腐蚀改变了含义。

source: I CANNOT AID YOU AT THIS TIME.
surface_observation: 原文仅表示此时无法提供帮助，译文没空帮你将原因限定为没有时间。
